description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Spore Frog from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Spore Frog from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability
Repeat
